BiblicalUsage: Hararite = "mountain dweller"; adj; 1) a resident in or descendant of Harar; perhaps only a mountain dweller; n pr m; 2) Agee, a Hararite, one of David's heroes; 3) Shammah, the Hararite, one of David's heroes; 4) Sharar, the Hararite, the father of Ahiam, one of David's heroes
